label: Qwen Code Access
description: A Qwen Code login, for the QwenCode nodes' `access`: a key for any OpenAI-compatible API (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, pay as you go) or an Anthropic key. One access for however many QwenCode nodes. A Coding Plan key is not offered: Alibaba's terms forbid using it for automated scripts and workflow platforms. On your machine, leave `access` out to use your own login.

steps: Create a pay-as-you-go key in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, or with any provider that speaks the OpenAI API.
Fill in the provider's base URL (Model Studio's console shows it) and paste the key, then name the connection.
Open console.anthropic.com, Settings > API Keys, and create a key.
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that account.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the QwenCode nodes' `access` input.
